capabilities: Add a unique ID to the frontmatter of edited Markdown files
Add an ID to all notes with one command
extras: The README links to Obsidian documentation pages (links stripped here) and mostly contains release instructions for maintainers (jq, gh, make).
problem: Obsidian does not assign a stable unique identifier to each note, which makes it hard to reference notes externally or reliably.
summary: Plugin that adds a globally unique ID to the frontmatter of every Markdown file you edit, with a command to add IDs to all notes.
